remarks: Experience the ultimate in coastal living with this classic 2002 Roger Bartels home. Spanning 4,400 square feet, this stunning residence features four bedrooms and five and a half baths, all boasting picturesque views of Farm Creek and Long Island Sound. Nestled within a private association, you'll enjoy access to a neighborhood beach and small craft launch, ensuring every room is graced with beautiful vistas.  The first floor offers 2,190 square feet of spacious living, including a living room, formal dining room, kitchen, family room, and office. The second floor is home to a spacious primary suite, a convenient laundry room, and two additional en-suite bedrooms. On the third floor, you'll find another en-suite bedroom, a bonus space, and a fabulous deck perfect for taking in the stunning sound views.  Meticulously landscaped and ready for you to move in, this home is just a short walk to town and provides easy access to the Metro North train station. This is a lifestyle opportunity you won't want to miss!
